theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : StrictMono f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s < f (insert a s) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intro s a ha
    have h_insert : StrictMonoOn f (insert a s) := strictMono_domRestrict.1 h (insert a s)
    rw [strictMono_domRestrict.2 (insert a s)]
    exact strictMonoOn_insert_iff.1 (λ b hb, by cases hb with hbs hba; exact (hbs ▸ ha))
  · intros h'
    refine strictMono_domRestrict.2 (λ s, _)
    induction s with s IH using Finset.induction
    · exact strictMono_on_empty
    · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 s with ⟨a, ha⟩ | ⟨a, ha⟩
      · have h_insert : StrictMonoOn f (insert a s) := strictMonoOn_insert_iff.2 (λ b hb, by cases hb with hbs hba; exact (hbs ▸ ha))
        rw [strictMonoOn_insert_iff.1 (λ b hb, by cases hb with hbs hba; exact (hbs ▸ ha))]
        exact (h' s a ha)
      · have h_insert : StrictMonoOn f (insert a s) := strictMonoOn_insert_iff_of_forall_ge.2 (λ b hb, by cases hb with hbs hba; exact (hbs ▸ ha)) (λ b hb, by cases hb with hbs hba; exact (hbs ▸ ha))
        rw [strictMonoOn_insert_iff_of_forall_ge.1 (λ b hb, by cases hb with hbs hba; exact (hbs ▸ ha))]
        exact (h' s a ha)
